Semua kolom wajib terisi. PK payment men: Every column is required. The payment PK enforces one identity; the required invoice FK enforces one owner. An invoice may have no payments. The legacy string list does not supply relationships in the redesigned model.
Satu invoice memiliki 0..N payment; seti: One invoice has 0..N payments; each payment must reference exactly one invoice under the example policy.
Semua kolom wajib terisi. Pada item, ord: Every column is required. On items, order_id and line_no jointly form the PK; order_id is also an FK. Transaction price remains on items, while customer and product names are current facts. A table repeated across relationship pairs remains the same entity.
Satu customer memiliki 0..N order; setia: One customer has 0..N orders; each order must have exactly one customer. A customer without orders can still be stored.
Satu order memiliki 0..N item; setiap it: One order has 0..N items; each item must reference exactly one order. The composite PK identifies a line within the order.
Satu product dapat dipakai 0..N item tra: One product can appear in 0..N transaction items; each item must reference exactly one SKU. Agreed price remains an item fact rather than being determined by SKU alone.
